symptom: The independently reviewed v0.1.25 D0 is a valid scope-only non-executable decision selecting the registered official Polymarket market-scoped-trade response class, but no current reviewed production path converts that decision into one exact request manifest.
source_evidence: AGENT_LOG_GATE1_V0125_D0_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_2026-09-28.md, the immutable D0 decision/provenance, ARCHITECTURE.md, and the current published compiler/fetch modules.
objective: Produce a locally tested and independently reviewed minimal trusted bridge from the exact D0 source/response choice to a deterministic non-executing documentation request manifest, without changing the Controller scientific choice or performing a network request.
boundary: Offline only: no provider call, credential read, network, document/public-data fetch, purchase, catalog/Train/Dev/Final access or admission, training, evaluation, commit, tag, push or release. The bridge may use only code-owned registered identifiers and fixed official URLs; model-supplied URLs, parameters, authority, redirects, retries and scope expansion must fail closed. Any publication, fresh canary and actual fetch require separate authorization.
resolution_check: Two independent read-only audits must agree on the exact current gap and request/fetch safety contract. Supervisor may then implement one minimal offline bridge on the pinned source snapshot, run focused and full relevant tests, and obtain a fresh independent integrated review. Resolution means only a reviewed local release candidate; it grants no publication or fetch authority.
